item.title: Style Homeware Recalls Emerspring Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from January 2026 through May 2026 for $226.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com from January 2026 through May 2026 for $226.
item.summary: This recall involves Emerspring Mattresses. The mattresses are 12 inches thick and sold in queen size. They have a white top and white sides with a green trim. They were sold compressed in a box. “Prototype ID: EMERS-12” and the manufacture date “6/2025” are printed on a sewn-in white label located on one side of the mattress.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Style Homeware to receive a free fitted cover to put over their mattress, which will bring the mattress into compliance with mandatory flammability standards.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
